reviewFlags.issue: Israeli retail and price-comparison listings name this coffee machine EN80B or EN80.B, not EN80.BAE. The Israeli variant and its importer are unclear, so no Israeli source was used.
Power 1260 W, voltage, water tank, capacity, warm-up time, dimensions, weight and cable length are not confirmed on any page naming EN80.BAE. Sibling-model pages were found but were not used.
Manufacturer pages give different warranty periods: 3 years on the Spanish page and 2 years on the Dutch page. The Israeli warranty must be checked.
The catalog name says the machine includes an Aeroccino 3 frother. The manufacturer pages checked do not confirm this, and one retailer question asks whether the frother is included.
Catalog model EN80-BAE is written EN80.BAE on manufacturer pages. Same model, different punctuation.
Israeli listings name the machine EN80B / EN80.B rather than EN80.BAE; the Israeli variant and importer are unclear.
Catalog name says an Aeroccino 3 frother is included; no verified quote confirms it for this SKU.
Catalog power, voltage, water tank, capsule capacity, warm-up time, dimensions, weight and cable length are not verified on any page naming this model.
Manufacturer pages in different countries state different warranty periods; Israeli warranty must be checked.

qa.notes: All three facts and both features are backed by ok quotes on De'Longhi manufacturer pages naming EN80.BAE. Catalog specs for power, voltage, water tank, capsule capacity, warm-up time, dimensions, weight and cable length are unverified and not published.
